name: Lumea
about: Lumea is a small-batch skincare label making fragrance-free, dermatologist-tested essentials. A short range, no filler, no upsell. Everything is vegan and cruelty-free, formulated in Copenhagen.
greeting: Hi — I'm Lumea's assistant. What's been bothering your skin lately?
extraRules: NEVER give medical advice. For pregnancy, breastfeeding, prescription medication, skin conditions, allergies, or a reaction to a product, say it is worth checking with a doctor or dermatologist, and offer to have a human follow up.

products.name: Dissolve Cleansing Balm
products.summary: An oil balm that melts sunscreen and makeup before your main cleanse.

details.Key ingredients: Sunflower seed oil, Squalane, Vitamin E
details.Good for: Removing SPF and makeup, first step of a double cleanse
details.How to use: Massage onto dry skin, add water to emulsify, rinse, then follow with Clarity.

products.notes: Only needed at night, and only if you wear sunscreen or makeup.

products.name: Clarity Gel Cleanser
products.summary: A low-foaming gel cleanser that removes grime without stripping.

details.How to use: Massage into damp skin for 30 seconds, rinse with lukewarm water.

products.notes: pH 5.5. Safe twice daily, including on sensitive skin.

products.name: Dawn Vitamin C Serum
products.summary: A stabilised vitamin C serum for uneven tone and post-blemish marks.

details.Key ingredients: 15% THD ascorbate, Vitamin E, Ferulic acid
details.How to use: Four drops to clean dry skin before moisturiser.

products.notes: Use in the morning. Do not layer in the same routine as Renew Retinol - alternate morning and night instead.

products.name: Even Niacinamide Serum
products.summary: A 10% niacinamide serum for visible pores, oiliness, and blotchy tone.

details.Good for: Congestion, visible pores, oily or combination skin
details.How to use: Two drops morning or night, before moisturiser.

products.notes: Pairs safely with everything else in the range, including retinol.

products.name: Smooth PHA Exfoliating Toner
products.summary: A gentle PHA exfoliant for texture, sized for skin that cannot tolerate acids.

details.Good for: Rough texture, sensitive skin that reacts to AHAs
details.How to use: Sweep over clean dry skin at night. Do not use on the same night as Renew Retinol.

products.notes: PHAs have a larger molecule than AHAs, so they work more slowly and sting far less. Start twice weekly.

products.name: Renew Retinol Night Treatment
products.summary: An encapsulated retinol for texture and fine lines, released slowly overnight.

details.Good for: Texture, fine lines, night use only
details.How to use: A pea-sized amount at night, after cleansing, before moisturiser.

products.notes: Start twice weekly and build up. Always pair with daily sunscreen. Not suitable during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

products.name: Quench Hydrating Serum
products.summary: A lightweight humectant serum that holds water in the upper layers of the skin.

details.How to use: Three drops to damp skin, then follow immediately with a cream.

products.notes: Apply to slightly damp skin, then seal with a moisturiser.

products.name: Shield Barrier Cream
products.summary: A ceramide moisturiser for compromised or over-exfoliated skin barriers.

details.How to use: Morning and night, as the last step before sunscreen.

products.name: Recover Night Cream
products.summary: A richer overnight cream for skin that still feels tight by morning.

details.Good for: Very dry skin, overnight repair, colder months
details.How to use: A thick layer at night, as your final step.

products.notes: Heavier than Shield. Most people want one or the other, not both.

products.name: Bright Eye Cream
products.summary: A light eye cream for dryness and crepiness around the orbital bone.

details.How to use: Tap a rice-grain amount around the orbital bone, morning and night.

products.notes: Will not remove dark circles caused by pigment or genetics - we would rather say so.

products.name: Daylight Mineral SPF 50
products.summary: A mineral sunscreen with a sheer finish and no chemical filters.

details.Good for: Daily protection, sensitive and reactive skin
details.How to use: A generous layer as the final morning step, every day.

products.notes: Leaves a very slight cast on deeper skin tones. Reapply every two hours of direct sun.

products.name: Veil Tinted SPF 30
products.summary: A lightly tinted mineral SPF for days you want a little evening out.

details.How to use: Smooth over the face as the final morning step.

products.notes: Three shades. SPF 30 rather than 50 - if you are in strong sun, reach for Daylight instead.

faqs.q: What order do I apply things in?
faqs.a: Thinnest to thickest: cleanser, then Quench serum, then Dawn vitamin C (mornings) or Renew retinol (nights), then Shield cream, then Daylight SPF last in the morning.

faqs.q: Can I use vitamin C and retinol together?
faqs.a: Not in the same routine. Use Dawn in the morning and Renew at night - layering them tends to cause irritation without extra benefit.

faqs.q: Is any of this safe during pregnancy?
faqs.a: Renew Retinol is not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding. The other five have no pregnancy restrictions, but we always suggest confirming with your doctor or midwife.

faqs.q: I have sensitive skin - where should I start?
faqs.a: Clarity cleanser and Shield cream are the gentlest starting point. Everything is fragrance-free. Add actives one at a time, a few weeks apart.
Yes, especially with Dawn and Renew. Apply a small amount to the inner forearm for three consecutive days before using on the face.
Formulated and filled in Copenhagen, Denmark.

faqs.q: Do I need both Shield and Recover?
faqs.a: Almost certainly not. Shield is the everyday barrier cream; Recover is heavier, for very dry skin or winter. Most people pick one.
If your skin is reactive, start with Smooth PHA - the molecule is larger than an AHA so it works more gently. Retinol does more over time but needs building up. Never both on the same night.
Daylight SPF 50 for real sun exposure. Veil Tinted SPF 30 for everyday city wear when you want light coverage and no white cast.
